title: One PAC · six checks · one vendor
description: Section illustration: a donut chart (97% of opposition spending = Pine Tree Results PAC, $10,723,548; $353,625 everyone else) beside six red check blocks converging by arrows on a single box labeled SRCP MEDIA, sole payee on all six buys.
alt_text: Dark graphic titled “one PAC · six checks · one vendor.” A donut chart shows 97 percent of opposition spending in red. Beside it, six red blocks with amounts from $1,501,012 to $1,999,500 point with arrows to one box labeled SRCP Media, sole payee on all six buys.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
